notes.title: Version 0.4.1 release
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kNu8x5uMlZE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Convenience store part-time job.[/h3]
Now it's possible to earn additional money by working part-time in convenience store. The job consists of two tasks: calculating correct amount of change for customers buying goods (x10), and cooking castella cakes and placing them into hot food showcase (x5). The job can be finished any time, and amount of payment will depend on amount of completed tasks.

The job can be started once per 24 hours, from 0 AM to 6 AM. More detailed instructions are provided by the store staff girl.

All NPCs now have two types of favorite food that they will buy in the conbini, and additional lines for shopping interactions. A new child NPC will occasionally appear in the shop and attempt to buy something offering pine cones for payment. She is not available for any other interactions apart from shopping, for now.

Amount of free money receieved weekly through ATM is decreased (30k - 20k - 10k) to balance gameplay after introduction of the new feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/e4e8a1bece92298b619ef701bf38947464d4c90f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cassette music player.[/h3]
Audio cassettes (x6) can be obtained from gachapon machine in conbini. The player can be placed at home, or carried in hand. Music volume can be adjusted in settings > system.

New items in conbini to buy:
[list]
[*] Uchiwa hand fan (shelf with anime merchandise). Can be placed in hand and used to get temporary cooling bonus in hot weather.
[*] Instant miso (x4 types) and instant tonjiru soups.
[*] New t-shirts for girls (x4 designs).
[*] Scarves (x2 colors). Can be equipped by placing them into the new "neck" slot.
[*] Air fan. Can be placed in apartment. Consumes electricity. Decreases ambient temperature by 3 degrees when turned on.
[*] Honey (used for castella recipe).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/0c40fa872c3fadb2d0f29e5f20b1680962bd28e8.jpg[/img]

Other new additions:
[list]
[*] Collars for cosplay (with and without suzu bell). Can be obtained in the school drama club room (require club membership).
[*] Castella cake recipe (sweet batter + honey).
[*] More posters and details in the convenience store.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skill requirement affecting chances of successful NPC interaction is now explicitly shown in the "luck" panel on the right side of the screen. Each NPC now has only one skill requirement. This was done to simplify NPC interactions and make it more obvious how they are affected by your character's skills.
[*] Equipment slots are rearranged, now there are two separate equipment screens instead of three: first for full body, and second for head-specific accessories. "hold in left hand" and "hold in right hand" slots are moved into the first equipment screen for faster access. New "neck" slot (first equipment screen) can be used to wear scarves and collars.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several errors that caused incorrect initialization of NPCs with smaller height.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented updates of weather data in some cases.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented correct placement of objects on kotatsu table (if loading a saved game with objects placed on kotatsu table, please pick them up and place again).
[*] Fixed a minor issue with physics for short hair styles.
[*] Fixed a minor issue where occlusion script was initializing renderers with slight delay when loading a game saved inside school.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.4 release
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5M1GLMhGm-c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Nakagin Capsule Tower[/h3]
New home location is modeled after real life Nakagin Capsule Tower. Built in 1972 in Ginza, Tokyo, it consisted of 140 capsules attached around two main towers. The building represented "Japanese Metabolism" concept that incorporated ideas of organic biological growth into architecture. The design implied that over years capsules will be replaced and rearranged, similar to life cycles of living organisms. Real life building was demolished in 2022.

New location can be accessed from the main map navigation menu. Both apartment complex and Nakagin now require paying weekly rent. If rent is not paid, access will be locked until next payment (sleeping for free is possible in school infirmary or gym storage room).

Weekly money transfers via ATM on "normal" and "hard" mode were increased by 5k Yen to offset the new bills. Starting a new game or loading a game saved in earlier version will have 1 week of apartment complex rent already paid.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camera obstacle avoidance logic was reworked to resolve various issues with camera stutter/jitter when it has to adjust its path around complex geometry.
[*] Futon and mattress beds were slightly adjusted, so they will appear in different positions if apartment room is loaded from earlier save. Please pick them up and place again to fix their position.
[*] Added a check for obstacles in front of character when crouch button is pressed to prevent character getting inside walls and objects in various narrow spaces.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
Adjusted several colliders in the shrine map to prevent characters walking outside of map.

notes.title: Version 0.3.3 release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/9e3cc7916f2b9f85376d83ae673ae4ef5a5a7da6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Omikuji 1 ~ 100[/h3]
All omikuji are rewritten from a scratch. Now they contain one block of text, split into four sentences, each, approximately, corresponding to original Chinese verses (quatrains) known as 元三大師百籤 (Ganzan Daishi Hyakusen). My original goal was to recreate authentic omikuji texts used in real Japanese shrines, but this task turned out to be not quite feasible due to great deal of variety between different omikuji editions and their interpretations. So there isn't any single "authentic" standard. Original short verses composed of Chinese characters are full of poetic metaphors and ancient references, and make little sense even to native speakers without interpretation notes. And various shrines use different interpretations, often straying far away from original verses, and intentionally changing their meaning to fit modern context. And the more I researched, the more complex this topic became, so for long time I could not decide how to handle all of that.
Long story short, I finished the job, and all 100 omikuji fortunes now can be drawn from the box. In the final edition I opted for shorter texts instead of lengthy explanations, trying to keep everything as close to historical verses as possible. While also delivering intended overall message.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/2e15c2a54dd3e1550c9442de3209f3e048d55df9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Apartment electricity & bills[/h3]
Automatic adjustment of apartment room temperature is removed. Air conditioning unit now can be used for the same purpose, and will stabilize room temperature at +23 C. Can be turned on and off using control panel.
All electrical devices used in apartment room will consume electricity. New electricity metering device is installed in the apartment room, and can be used to control and pay for electricity.
If unpaid electricity reaches 1000 kWh (10,000 Yen), electricity will be cut off, and restored after bills are paid.
New kotatsu table can be bought in the convenience store and used as a cheaper alternative to AC. Kotatsu will add +3 degrees to any current room temperature (within limited area around table).
Sleeping in warm clothes is a free alternative to using any heating devices (also works IRL).

Convenience store additions: coconuts, 3 types of cups, blue alarm buzzer, new poster explaining effects of wearing backpacks.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New game logo design in the main menu.
[*] Object interactions limited to members of specific clubs now will show a notification explaining that they require club membership.
[*] Pan, pot, and kettle now can be placed on the floor or tables in apartment room.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed a minor bug with object interactions (e.g., catching squirrels) that were triggered twice if action button was pressed twice within a fraction of a second.
[*] fixed a bug when dynamic objects (basket balls) placed on top of furniture were falling through apartment floor and disappearing. Now they can be placed on top of furniture, but will fall on the floor if their parent furniture is moved. If any already bugged objects existed in a saved game, they will be automatically destroyed when apartment level is loaded.
[*] fixed a minor bug with wrong material properties for sneakers shoes.
[*] fixed a bug with current state (on/off) of apartment room lamps not being initialized correctly after loading apartment location.
[*] fixed a bug with kanji dictionary/workbook #3 not displaying content.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.3.2 release
notes.content:

"Squashed" versions of torus-type tails are removed, because they didn't really look good. Torus-type tails are now compatible only with hairstyles where tails are formed on the upper part of head. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/32256f0707f0a106c7848b5cfcc7cecbc53acab6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Several scripts controlling hair/skirt/flags/etc. physics were reworked to make animations more fluid and get rid of a few physics issues. When sleeping in bed, characters' hair will now remain on top of bed surface, instead of going through bed (depending on hairstyle, particularly for ponytails, some clipping still will happen).
[*] Character faces now have two separate equipment slots, allowing to wear both glasses and face mask/mustache at the same time. Item ids for face mask and mustache were changed, so their old versions (if any existed in inventory) will be marked as deleted items. New versions of these items are available in the same places in school.
[*] Implemented new occlusion culling system inside school (which is the most complex location) to improve performance. This should provide significant fps improvement while inside school.
[*] Various NPCs will be visiting convenience store after school (between 17 PM and 21 PM).
[*] NPCs in the jinja map will now walk through the main gate and appear/disappear in the street outside of camera view, instead of the spot right below the main gate.
[*] Content of all script books for drama club was reworked, many lines were shortened to make them easier to remember. Content of "Journey to the Center of the Earth" book is replaced with a different (more interesting) fragment.
[*] Attempting to move inventory-expanding items from equipment into additional inventory slots now results in a warning message notifying why that action is blocked.
[*] Backpack shoulder straps now have better adjustment.
[*] School history workbook was reworked and simplified, several unnecessarily difficult questions/answers were removed.
[*] Chance of prayer success in the shrine is increased (from 5% to 10% without coin, and from 10% to 20% with coin).
[*] Erika's list of requested snacks is simplified by removing food that required complex cooking, and replacing it with food that can be bought in convenience store.
[*] Reworked "help" section in the main menu. Now it also includes screenshots showing various game objectives/activities.
[*] Effect of "health" blessing/omamori is changed: now it reduces time of all received negative health effects by 50%. Does not affect stress and chance of poisoning.
[*] Freezing/warming mechanics are reworked. Exposure to hot/cold weather and consuming hot/cold drinks now affect the same single "accumulated warmth" parameter which can go from -100% to 100% (from "maximum freezing", resulting in flu, to "maximum overheating", resulting in heatstroke). Drinks can give up to +-33% warmth bonus (~1 hour protection against hot/cold weather). Freezing/warming accumulation speed now depend on current environment + clothes temperature, and can range from 3 to 1 hour to reach 100%. Wetness effect works the same as before and will always decrease body temperature by up to 5 degrees.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed a minor issue with drama book UI menu initialization.
[*] fixed a minor bug with position of Kuromoto's hat.
[*] fixed a bug with two buttons in convenience store being assigned to wrong glasses.
[*] fixed several minor issues with wrong footstep sounds on some surfaces.
[*] fixed a bug with NPC skirt physics initialization in a few rare scenarios.
[*] fixed a shader issue with shadows that were visible through hair.
[*] fixed wrong sitting positions on several types of chairs for characters with small height.
[/list]

[b]Update (March 12):[/b] released hotfix for energy/health regeneration issue for beds placed in apartment (for games loaded from earlier saves).

[h3]School drama club[/h3]
Drama club, located on the first floor of school, is fully functional and can be joined by talking with the club president (new NPC).
Script books for drama club activities can be obtained in the school library. Each book contains a fragment of text with dialogue between two characters, and can be studied from inventory menu, or from class desk menu. During drama club practice, you will have to recite correct lines for one of the characters, while your NPC partner will recite lines for the other character. Five books are available so far:
[list]
[*] The Hound of the Baskervilles
[*] Journey to the Center of the Earth
[*] Romeo and Juliet
[*] Oedipus Rex
[*] Dracula
[/list]
All NPCs (apart from conbini and food stall sellers) can be potentially invited for drama club activity, and have different drama skills reflecting their personalities. Shizuka and Kasumi will always recite accurate lines (thus making the practice easier), while other characters may say wrong lines, or forget their lines completely.

"Victory" omamori/blessing allows to make 1 error during the practice. Reward for successful drama practice is +1 arts skill. Each book can be used twice with the same NPC to obtain +2 arts skill maximum (once per book character). Your current experience for each book and currently invited NPC is shown in the book selection menu. Once your experience reaches 100%, you can either use a different book with the same NPC, or use the same book and invite a different NPC, to continue getting more arts skill points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/f63da2b11d428a8796676f6e58228c7db8d1d6c3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: What is Anime City?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/5b60e85fe9dba947a4ea770a0aa15ae84ef6a099.jpg[/img]

[h3]What this game is about?[/h3]

Shoujo City 2D, Shoujo City 3D, and the new game, Anime City, aren't sequels or remakes of each other, but new projects built from a scratch around the same core idea. The main difference between these projects is quality and scope, which are increasing with each iteration.

Tokimeki Memorial, one of best known examples of a classic anime dating sim, was my main source of inspiration. In this game, if you want to interact with a girl, first you must improve your skills, e.g., if that girl likes drawing paintings, you should improve your art skills. After that you can ask her out and go on a date to a shrine, amusement park, etc. That's the core game concept. Gameplay is mostly about reading texts appearing on screen (and making choices), and when it comes to improving you skills (another half of gameplay), you usually click on a button ("do music", "do sports", etc.), and your skills change without any further input.

The kind of game I always wanted to play is one built around the same concept, but where you can actually do all of these actions. E.g., if you want to improve your "music" skills to approach a girl from light music club, you'll actually have to learn playing musical instruments. And when you later go with that girl on a date to a shrine, you actually can try your luck with omikuji, buy candy apples at a food stall, etc.

That's the main reason why I started making video games and spent over 10 years already developing and refining a formula for a perfect anime school simulator. My main goal always was keeping aesthetics and traditions of a classic anime dating sim, but designing a game with fully interactive gameplay, where you always remain in control of everything you are doing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194639/21c98328c67cfd3d27d29f15ba6b8994fa0151f8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Future development[/h3]

Features that are planned for future updates after first release:
[list]
[*] More NPCs to interact with. The final goal is to add 8 characters who can be asked out on actual dates/interactions (4 boys and 4 girls). Right now there are only 2 girls.
[*] Full year cycle (affecting weather, foliage, harvestable resources) in addition to day/night cycle.
[*] At least 2 more school clubs (drama and photography) in addition to those already available (4).
[*] At least 2 more locations (Buddhist temple and shop for clothes).
[*] More content for each activity/feature. This goal doesn't have any specific target numbers, since most features can be expanded indefinitely (e.g., more clothes to wear, recipes to cook, plants to grow, etc.), so new content will be added here within limits of what can be reasonably achieved by a solo developer.
[/list]
